verdict.line: You lose trades before level 6 to poke and blind; you win the lane if you survive to 6 and start landing Q on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Teemo wins the lane with zero-risk ranged poke and a hard blind, so Mundo's job before level 6 is just not dying while shields absorb Toxic Shot stacks. The data backs this up directly — Teemo has the lane edge and the solo-kill edge, and the 47.6% head-to-head over 227 games is worse than Mundo's 50.3% overall top-lane win rate.

theirWindow.what: He can blind you on cooldown (8s) and auto freely while you're blinded, stacking Toxic Shot (E) for free poison damage. Don't commit to a trade or last-hit contest when his Q is available — back off and let Adrenaline Rush regen the chip damage instead.

yourWindow.when: level 6+, his Blinding Dart just used
yourWindow.what: Once you have Sadism (R) for the sustain/MS burst and his Q is on its 8s cooldown, step in and land Infected Cleaver (Q, 4s cooldown, 975 range) point-blank, then stick on him — he has no disengage besides Move Quick (W), which stops boosting the instant you hit him.

powerCurve.note: Blind + poke outranges your melee kit
Toxic Shot stacking punishes any auto trade
Sadism lets you force fights on cooldown
Tankiness and Masochism AD dominate teamfights

start.why: The flat 8 damage block on autos directly negates Toxic Shot's on-hit tick, the single most important stat check vs Teemo's poke; it's the pick in 79.7% of these games for a reason.

boots.why: Taken 61.1% of the time here — the flat move speed closes the gap on a kiting ranged champion and makes your Sadism (R) all-ins actually land instead of whiffing on a backpedaling Teemo.

core.why: Massive HP pool synergizes with Adrenaline Rush and Masochism's missing-health AD scaling, turning Teemo's poke into free stats for you
Converts the HP stacking into a damage source, letting you punish him once you've closed the gap
Amplifies your passive regen and Burning Agony (W) healthloss-sustain against a damage profile that's almost entirely magic

situational.when: he's grouping with his team and you need wave clear plus a sticking tool on tanky frontline targets
his team has multiple auto-attack or on-hit carries stacking slows/damage on you
he rushes lethality or crit items and his autos start actually hurting through your HP stacking

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp procs on autos he's forcing you to avoid anyway, so the sustain and max-HP scaling fit a lane where you're playing defensively, not trading autos

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 28.6% of games at 54.7% win rate, the highest of the three combos — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Burning Agony (W) wave clear while skipping the early losing trades, and Flash covers the gap-close Teemo's kiting otherwise denies.

playing.title: Never auto-trade into open Q
playing.detail: If Blinding Dart (8s cooldown) is up, any trade risks a free blind + unanswered Toxic Shot stacks. Wait him out.

playing.title: Track Camouflage idle timer
playing.detail: If he stops moving for a moment near a bush or trap line, he's about to go invisible — back off from likely Noxious Trap (R) zones rather than walking blind into a slow field.

playing.title: Use Burning Agony to clear waves fast
playing.detail: W's AoE drain lets you shove minion waves even while playing passive in trades, denying him easy farm under your tower pressure.

playing.title: Save Sadism for forced all-ins, not pokes
playing.detail: R's 75s cooldown is too long to waste on a half-health skirmish — hold it for the level 6+ window when you can actually close the gap and kill him before his kit resets.

playing.title: Respect the trap minefield near objectives
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has a 1s cooldown, meaning he can blanket chokepoints before drakes/herald. Walk wide or send a ward first instead of face-checking.

playing.title: Itemize Spirit Visage over pure HP if poisoned hard
playing.detail: If his E stacks are constantly ticking you down between fights, prioritize the healing amp — it directly counters sustained magic DoT better than raw Warmog's HP.

playing.title: Play around Teleport resets, not lane kills
playing.detail: Given the sub-50% head-to-head win rate, don't force level 1-5 kills — use Teleport to skip losing trades and let your level 6+ power spike decide the lane instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Although Teemo will have control over lane during early game, try to kill him after reaching level 6 when [Q] lands! Manage your health well while poking with [Q].
